item.title: Journey Financial Group To Acquire Lone Star Bank
item.description: Journey Financial Group (a Texas corporation) and Lone Star Bank (a Texas banking association headquartered in Houston) jointly announced the signing of a definitive agreement for Journey Financial Group to acquire Lone Star Bank. The transaction has been approved by the boards of directors of both companies and is expected to close in late second quarter or early third quarter of 2026, pending customary closing conditions including shareholder approval from Lone Star and regulatory approvals. item.title: Health Wave Partners: Acquisition Of Senior Living Community MorningStar Of Parker
item.description: Health Wave Partners announced it has acquired MorningStar Senior Living of Parker, a Class A senior housing campus located in Parker, Colorado, a suburb within the Denver metropolitan area. The transaction aligns with the Chicago-based investment platform’s strategy of acquiring high-quality senior housing communities and partnering with established operators in demographically favorable markets. item.title: Wasatch Photonics: $39 Million Acquisition By FOSS Group
item.description: FOSS announced that it has acquired North American spectrometer specialist Wasatch Photonics in a deal valued at just under DKK 250 million, or about $39 million. The acquisition marks one of the largest in the history of the Danish family-owned company and reflects its continued investments in photonics and optical technologies. item.title: Ondas: $175 Million Acquisition Of Defense Contractor Mistral
item.description: Ondas, a provider of autonomous systems and private wireless solutions, announced it has entered into a merger agreement to acquire U.S. defense prime contractor Mistral Inc., valued at approximately $175 million. The deal will see Mistral merge with a subsidiary of Ondas while continuing to manage its existing contract administration responsibilities. item.title: Sitemetric: Gemspring Capital Investment And Rich Riley Appointed CEO
item.description: Sitemetric, a provider of construction site security, access, and workforce technology and services, announced that an affiliate of Gemspring Capital has made an additional investment in the company while appointing Rich Riley as chief executive officer. The move reflects Gemspring’s continued backing of Sitemetric as demand grows across data center construction and broader building markets. item.title: Solution Tree: Acquisition Of Dirigo Literacy Expands K-12 Literacy Solutions

item.title: Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI): $1.03 Billion Raised For World Model AI Systems
item.description: Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI), an artificial intelligence company focused on developing world model–based AI systems, announced that it has raised $1.03 billion (approximately €890 million) in funding from a global group of investors. The financing round was co-led by Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, Hiro Capital, and HV Capital, with participation from Bezos Expeditions, along with additional investors and angel backers from around the world.
